_readme: Reference presets for the Nabe overlap gate (docs/house-preset-v0.md §6). Only repo-relative paths belong here. The third-party preset files are NOT in the repo (no license); the gate runs where they exist and skips missing paths (reporting them). Machine-specific absolute paths go in scripts/preset-references.local.json (untracked), or the KOTATSU_PRESET_REFS env var.
